##### Project general facts

Valore is a contemporary residential development, designed as a refined expression of modern urban living in Dubai. The project features a groung floor, 3 podium plus 16 residential floors, offering a curated collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, including spacious layouts with maid’s rooms. Set within Jumeirah Village Circle, it combines elegant architecture with strong investment appeal, high rental demand, and seamless connectivity to key destinations across the city.

The project offers a well-balanced lifestyle through a wide range of thoughtfully designed amenities. Residents can enjoy a temperature-controlled swimming pool with sunken seating, a fully equipped fitness center, yoga and meditation spaces, and a wellness zone with spa, steam, and sauna facilities. Additional features include a private movie theatre, co-working spaces, landscaped areas, outdoor seating zones, children’s play areas, and even an organic farming terrace, creating a vibrant and community-focused environment.

The interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, including porcelain flooring, premium paint, and bespoke wardrobes. Kitchens are fully fitted with integrated appliances such as a microwave-oven, hob, fridge-freezer, and washer-dryer, along with stone worktops and high-end cabinetry. Bathrooms are elegantly designed with branded sanitary ware, frameless glass showers, and refined fittings, ensuring a sophisticated and comfortable living experience. Residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
